name: Harem Inspector
source:
Harem inspector follows Lance Whitestaff who is a public harem inspector.

He is tasked with inspecting the harem belonging to Lord Maximus, a mysterious Harem owner who has set his harem on a castle in the middle of the ocean. You now have to speak to each of the courtesans and make sure that they are treated well.

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/harem-inspector]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Harem Inspector》围绕公职后宫监察员兰斯·怀特斯塔夫展开。

他受命检查马克西穆斯领主的后宫。这位神秘的后宫主人，将自己的女人们安置在海中央的一座城堡中。你必须与每位侍姬交谈，确认她们得到了妥善对待。

[摘自[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/harem-inspector]itch.io[/url]]
